title: Astrid and the Weather
author: Ansel Villalobos
blurb: Lena Montrose, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
